info.title: Sirocco-Obfuscator
info.description: Sirocco-Obfuscator is a powerful .NET obfuscator with control flow, string encryption, anti-debug, and anti-tamper protection.

options.name: --rename
options.description:
Enable basic renaming (private fields/methods/nested types).
This is a prerequisite for type/namespace renaming.

options.name: --rename-types
options.description:
Rename class names (non-public classes; if --public is set, all classes).
Requires --rename.

options.name: --public
options.description:
Obfuscate public/protected members (may break external calls).
[Encryption]

options.name: --stringsAES
options.description: Use AES-256 encryption (dynamic per-string keys), more secure.

options.name: --res-enc
options.description:
Encrypt embedded resources (e.g., images, configs) and decrypt at runtime.
[Control Flow Obfuscation]

options.name: --controlflow
options.description:
Enable control flow obfuscation (switch flattening + opaque predicates + jump mangling),
significantly increasing reverse‑engineering difficulty.

options.name: --ref-proxy
options.description:
Enable reference proxy (experimental), hides direct method call relationships.
[Anti-Debug & Anti-VM]

options.name: --antidebug
options.description: Inject anti‑debug protection (detects Debugger.IsAttached), silently exits when debugged.

options.name: --antivm
options.description: Inject anti‑VM detection (processes, MAC, registry etc.), exits on detection.

options.name: --antitamper
options.description:
Inject anti‑tamper protection to detect IL modifications in entry point method.
Conflicts with packing.
[Memory Protection]

options.name: --memory-erasure
options.description: Clear temporary byte arrays after AES decryption to prevent plaintext residues.

options.name: --anti-dump
options.description:
Anti‑memory‑dump (may affect debugging), blocks memory dumping tools.
[Packing]

options.name: --pack
options.description:
Pack the obfuscated assembly with a stub (requires Stub.exe). Only outputs EXE, 64‑bit only.
